**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Close D2 PR3 on issue #259 / governance thread #297: wire brain-audit's reverter-skip onto the frozen net-parity primitives, close every fail-open the finder could prove, and take the slice through the fifth gate to closure.

## Instructions (owner preferences learned)
- Verify before agreeing — the owner explicitly values "I went to check expecting to explain it away, and it holds" over quick assent.
- Design/doctrine forks go to the decision-review circuit (comments on the issue), never resolved in chat.
- Outward-facing actions (push, PR, issue comment, close) are confirmed first; the owner authorizes each with a short "dale".
- Measure, never estimate: every claim about a fix's cost must be implemented, run, and reverted before it is written down.

## Discoveries
- **A gate that is not mechanized is not a gate, it is an intention.** The thread's convergent lesson, paid for three times: a wrong ruling (mechanism named but never run), an orphaned merge at P289 instance two (warning existed in engram AND both PR bodies), and a hard merge blocker rendered as `verdict: APPROVE` with the block buried in a `conditions:` array.
- **Any "did my change survive to the tip" test is degenerate for every tip-most merge.** `(c′)` only escapes it because a pure delete has no added paths and passes VACUOUSLY. This killed one of my own proposed options under measurement.
- **`serializeRecord` returns NO trailing newline — `appendRecord` adds it.** Raw `appendFileSync` produced a `}{` join (two JSON objects on one line) in the real `.memory` store, and **`npm test` plus the REQ-C4-1 round-trip both stayed GREEN over the corrupt file**. Caught from the diffstat (`1 insertion AND 1 deletion` on an append-only file), not from any test.
- **`source` is excluded from the record id hash but NOT from the round-trip** — `exportObservation` re-synthesizes provenance prose from it.
- Slice PRs here use `Part of #N`, not `Closes` (the workflow branches on base == main). `gh pr edit --add-label` fails with a GraphQL Projects-classic error; use `gh api .../labels`. Budget must be measured against the PR base, not `origin/main`.
- A finder fixture should pin assertions that **constrain the fix**, not only the bug — otherwise the patcher can satisfy it by deleting the signal.

## Accomplished
- **#298 (PR3a)**, **#300 (PR3b, restored)**, **#301 (PR3c)** all merged into `feature/v2.0.0` @ `eda8d85`.
- Guard `(c′)` `addedPathsAbsentAt` authored; widened to `--diff-filter=AM` to close A10.
- Finder fixtures A8, A10, A11 frozen RED before their fixes; A11 remains frozen for pre-PR4 work.
- Held items landed: audited-tip anchoring (MINOR 1), throwing per-merge reads (MINOR 2, swallowing helper deleted), SIG drift-guard.
- Orphaned-merge incident diagnosed, escalated, and repaired via #300 (reviewed by tree identity — same tree sha as the thrice-verified commit).
- Owner's `R297-APPROVE-READS-AS-GO` finding verified and ratified; schema debt routed to #284.
- P289 record AUTHORED at instance two (it had no repo home at all); PR4 `[FAIL-SHA]` precondition bound as a durable record.
- **Fifth gate PASSED** (29/29 frozen set, 1822/1822 suite green under shipped wiring; A7/A8/A10 all granted by the faithful mutant; A6 the discriminating cell). **#297 and #259 CLOSED.**

## Next Steps
- **Pre-PR4 (patcher)**: implement the modify-shaped-denial suppression so a removal-only merge is reported but never carries `[FAIL-SHA]`, turning A11 green. Bound by `rec-779629c7` — PR4 must not consume `[FAIL-SHA]` before this lands.
- **Owner keystrokes**: promote the two anti-pattern drafts in `openspec/changes/issue-259-d2/brain-drafts/`; decide the enforcement shape for `blocked:<ref>` label + required check (Tier-2 doctrine).
- **#284**: carries the `brain-review/2` schema bump including `verdict: BLOCKED` + `blocked_by:`.
- Uncovered and recorded: `T` (typechange) in the liveness guard — no fixture, no machinery, evidence-first.
- Possible gap raised, not built: a structural-integrity test for `.memory/records` (a green suite over a malformed store).

## Relevant Files
- `brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/resolution.mjs` — net-parity primitives + `addedPathsAbsentAt` (the `(c′)` guard, now `AM`)
- `brain/scripts/brain-audit.mjs` — the two skips, the exemption site, class-filtered `[FAIL-SHA]`
- `brain/scripts/brain-audit.test.mjs` — frozen finder fixtures A7/A8/A10 (+A11 on its own branch)
- `brain/scripts/lib/audit-helpers.mjs` — `auditedTip(range)`
- `.memory/records/2026-07.jsonl` — P289 record, PR4 binding, the two lesson records
- `openspec/changes/issue-259-d2/design.md` — §15, §15.5a
- `openspec/changes/issue-259-d2/brain-drafts/` — two promotion candidates
